sections.title: Traits
lines:
Metallic Awakening (recharges after a short or long rest). When the creature would drop to 0 HP, set its current HP to 450, recharge Breath Weapon, and restore all spent uses of Legendary Resistance. The creature can take mythic actions for the following hour. Award 120,000 extra XP if defeated after this trait activates (240,000 XP total).
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Unusual Nature. The greatwyrm needs no food or drink.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) slashing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 20) and restrained until the grapple ends. The greatwyrm can hold only one creature with this attack at a time.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 26 Strength save or fall prone.
Breath Weapon (recharge 5–6). Choose Elemental Breath or Sapping Breath.
Elemental Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 84 (13d12) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sapping Breath. Each creature in a 300-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Constitution save. A failure leaves the creature unconscious for 1 minute. An unconscious creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the first save has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the greatwyrm’s next turn.

sections.title: Legendary actions
lines:
The creature has 3 legendary actions. It can take one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw or Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 26 Dexterity save or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The greatwyrm can then fly up to half its flying speed.

sections.title: Mythic actions
lines:
For 1 hour after Metallic Awakening activates, the greatwyrm can spend legendary actions on these options.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack.
Shattering Roar (2 actions). Each creature in a 120-ft.-radius sphere centered on the greatwyrm must succeed on a DC 26 Constitution save or take 19 (3d12) thunder damage and be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

sections.title: Dragon customization
lines: Customize the dragon’s languages or skills to suit its history. Skill changes can include double proficiency or tool proficiencies. Use the optional innate spellcasting guidance for the dragon’s color when adding magic. Other options on p. 34 include alternate senses and the Change Shape, Flyby, Mimicry, Rejuvenation, and Tunneler traits or actions.

lines:

Incendiary Smoke. The scion creates a 30-ft.-radius sphere of smoke and embers centered on itself that moves with it. Ranged attacks against the scion have disadvantage while it emits smoke. A creature that enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 14 (4d6) fire damage unless it makes a DC 25 Constitution save. The smoke ends after 1 minute, when the scion dies, or when the scion uses this bonus action to stop it.

sections.title: Cradle encounter
lines: The Cradle of the Fire Scion protects the sleeping scion. When the cradle drops to 0 HP, the scion appears immediately in the cradle’s space and uses its initiative count.

sections.title: Regional effects
lines:
Use one or more of these effects around the scion.
Abundant Ore. Precious metals and ore are unusually common within 6 miles.
Desertification. Almost no precipitation falls within 6 miles, drying the land and withering most plants.
Empowered Fire Giants. Fire giants within 1,000 ft. gain +8 to attack and damage rolls.
On the scion’s death, ore veins stop forming and the other effects end immediately. Existing ore remains.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Legendary Resistance (6/Day). When the scion fails a save, it can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The scion makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Siege Monster. The scion deals double damage to objects and structures.

sections.title: Actions
lines:
Multiattack. Make one Ice Axe attack and two Slam attacks, or make two Glacier Throw attacks.
Ice Axe. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (4d12 + 10) force damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 32 (4d10 + 10) force damage.
Glacier Throw. Ranged weapon attack, +17 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (4d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage. The target falls prone unless it makes a DC 25 Strength save.
Glacial Upheaval (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 30 ft. The scion digs into the ground and launches conjured ice. Each creature other than the scion in a 30-ft.-radius, 100-ft.-high cylinder centered on the point makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. A failure deals 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) cold damage and pushes the creature vertically to the top of the cylinder, from which it falls. Success halves the damage and pushes it to the nearest unoccupied space outside the cylinder. At the start of the scion’s next turn, the ice falls at a visible point within 60 ft. of the original point. Center another 30-ft.-radius, 100-ft.-high cylinder there. Each creature in it makes a DC 25 Dexterity save or takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) cold damage.
